def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    # Find the frame color and the repeated horizontal separator rows.
    frame = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == frame for v in row[:5])]
    bands = [(separators[i] + 1, separators[i + 1]) for i in range(len(separators) - 1)]

    # Collect each colored 3x3 object and sort by size, then color.
    objects = []
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row) - {0, frame}:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        objects.append((len(cells), color, cells))
    objects.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))

    out = [row[:5] for row in grid]
    for (top, bottom), (_, color, cells) in zip(bands, objects):
        for r, c in cells:
            out[top + (r - min(x[0] for x in cells))][1 + (c - min(x[1] for x in cells))] = color
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The left panel ends immediately before the all-zero divider.
    split = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == 0 for row in grid))
    panel = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    frame = panel[0][0]

    # Read the colored silhouettes on the right, normalized to their top-left.
    shapes = {}
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, frame)}:
        cells = [(r, c - split) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                 for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        minr = min(r for r, c in cells)
        minc = min(c for r, c in cells)
        shapes[frozenset((r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in cells)] = color

    separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(panel) if all(v == frame for v in row)]
    for top, end in zip(separators, separators[1:]):
        cells = [(r - top - 1, c) for r in range(top + 1, end)
                 for c in range(1, split - 1) if panel[r][c] == 0]
        if not cells:
            continue
        minr = min(r for r, c in cells)
        minc = min(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = frozenset((r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in cells)
        color = shapes.get(shape)
        if color is not None:
            for r, c in cells:
                panel[top + 1 + r][c] = color
    return panel
